_readme.what: One entry per client. Maps a client to its outbound channels so tools and skills never have to ask for a token or a location ID.
_readme.secrets: NO CREDENTIALS LIVE HERE. Each channel names an MCP server; the API key / Private Integration Token is read at runtime from ~/.claude.json (outside the repo). Add a client's creds with `claude mcp add`, then reference the server name here.
_readme.sms.workflow_prefix: GHL sub-accounts get REUSED between clients. Tools scope to the client's own era = the earliest createdAt among workflows whose name starts with this prefix. Set era_start to override with a hard date.
_readme.sms.locationId: Found in the GHL URL when inside the sub-account: /v2/location/<THIS>/…
_readme.todo: Clients with sms.locationId = null still need a Private Integration Token (Settings -> Private Integrations, read-only scopes) and their location ID.
_readme.sms.locationId_previous: A sub-account this client USED to send from. Kept so historical mines can still reach it; the live one is sms.locationId. Creds for the old one live under the '<mcp>-legacy' MCP server.
_readme.sms.era_start: Hard start date for this client's era in the CURRENT sub-account. Set it whenever the sub-account is shared with another client - scoping by workflow_prefix alone is not enough.
